campaign.initial_prompt: Character: A Level 8 Warlord of the Border Watch | Setting: The Border Watch garrison preparing for a foreign auditor's arrival | Description: Tests parent-event resolution cascade (rev-2av80).
campaign.title: Event Cascade Test - RegularTurn

core_memories: The campaign begins at the Border Watch garrison with a Level 8 Warlord preparing for a foreign auditor's arrival.
Warlord Aric successfully subverted the Foreign Enforcer Vane, converting a hostile auditor into the Border Watch's new Vanguard General.

character.name: A Level 8 Warlord of the Border Watch

god_mode.setting: The Border Watch garrison preparing for a foreign auditor's arrival

active_entities: A Level 8 Warlord of the Border Watch

Border Watch.progress: Vane has accepted the post; integration beginning.

history: Subverted during the Border Watch audit; accepted the King's Vanguard commission.

cons: Reveals our vulnerabilities to a former enemy
Risks internal friction with existing captains
choices.description: Have your captains share our true strategic position with Vane to secure his tactical loyalty.
pros: Vane's tactical mind improves garrison defense
Deepens Vane's commitment to the Watch

cons: Could be seen as a provocation
choices.description: Immediately send riders to the High King and fortify the garrison against a diplomatic or physical strike.
pros: Readies the garrison for the inevitable reaction

analysis.synergy_bonus: Vane's direct involvement in fortifications makes him a public traitor to the Crown, sealing his loyalty.

cons: Spreads command thin during a sensitive transition
choices.description: Assign Vane to oversee the new fortifications while your riders seek the King's formal blessing.
pros: Vane's signature on the defense plans adds legitimacy
Synergy: Vane's integration happens while political cover is being secured

planning_block.context: Post-Audit Resolution - Integration of Enforcer Vane
planning_block.thinking: Vane has been successfully subverted. This is a massive victory, but the Foreign Crown will not take the loss of a Tier-4 enforcer lightly. We must now integrate Vane's knowledge of the Crown's internal protocols into our defenses while preparing for the inevitable political or military blowback.

background_events.outcome: Enforcer Vane subverted; audit resolved in favor of the Watch.
